last_result.headline: Q56's 760-well run landed: 760/760 wells usable, forward 9.2903 (reconstruction check against the deployed 9.2987 holds at the same 0.008 NS offset Q36 found). The ancestral-path smoother gives NESTED +0.2541 at blend level, helps 68.9% of wells with a POSITIVE median +0.2044, and fails only the 3-well bootstrap 5th (-0.3238, P(>0) 0.7919). The 12-well smoke over-stated the size by 58% -- predicted in advance, and the reusable lesson is that a smoke is an activation check, not a size. Everything that made it credible survived: the lookahead dose-response is still monotone on 760 wells, and the savgol control shows ~90% of the gain is lookahead rather than denoising. It is NOT tail-driven, which is the opposite of the GR-sigma signature that preceded the 54878409 public regression. For scale it is worth ~60% of the entire structural-field stage. Not promoted; queued q58 to reproduce it in the honest kernel and RE-FIT the structural field against the smoothed PF, since that stage was fitted against the forward PF and its +0.436 is not transferable as-is.
